$comment: Semantic colour roles for the proposal decks. Recolouring works by mapping every literal colour found in the golden PDFs back to a role, then re-emitting the role's value from the active theme. `aliases` therefore lists the observed hexes from BOTH decks - they use slightly different values for the same role, because the two templates were built at different times.

brandDeep.description: Full-bleed dark background on the cover and investment pages.

brandDeepAlt.description: Deeper tone used for the layered cover circles.

primary.description: Primary accent. Eyebrows, numerals, key figures, cover circle.

primaryLight.description: Lighter primary for the cover wordmark and circle highlights.

primaryTint.description: Pale primary wash behind highlighted cards.

secondary.description: Secondary accent. Icons, rules, bullet dots, INCLUDES headings.

secondaryTint.description: Pale secondary wash behind supporting cards.

ink.description: Headings and emphasised text on light backgrounds.

body.description: Default body copy on light backgrounds.

muted.description: Captions, footnotes and source lines on light backgrounds.

onDarkFaint.description: Page footers sitting on brandDeep - a step quieter than onDarkMuted. Kept separate because collapsing the two loses a real distinction in the original decks.

surfaceOnDark.description: Raised panel sitting on brandDeep - the INCLUDES box on the investment page.

hairline.description: Dividers, card outlines and footer rules.

success.description: Positive status marks (What's already working ticks).

successTint.description: Pale wash behind positive status blocks.

danger.description: Problem/challenge marks in the audit findings.

warning.description: Caution marks where a finding needs confirmation.
